description: Caller just wants to know when the tech is coming — a pure lookup, not a change. Must be answered from find_appointment with no new booking and no message taken; before find_appointment existed, this got a callback message taken about a job already sitting in the database.

caller.opening: Hi, it's Jamie Cole — I just wanted to check what time you're coming out on Wednesday.
caller.persona: Jamie Cole, who already has an emergency-plumbing job booked for Wednesday at 200 Elm Ct, Austin. Just wants the arrival time confirmed — nothing else needs to change.
caller.goal: find out what time the Wednesday appointment is. Once told, say thanks and hang up. You do not want anything rescheduled, cancelled, or a new appointment booked.
